name: Adaptive Simplicial Partitioning with Dual Vertices
aliases: Dual vertex placement on simplicial partitions
definition: A method to create a partition of space for isosurface extraction by placing dual vertices within minimal cells of an octree, constrained to lie within the cell (scaled by 1-ε) to avoid degenerate tetrahedra and T-intersections.
summary: Adaptive Simplicial Partitioning with Dual Vertices is an isosurface extraction method that minimizes sliver triangles by placing dual vertices inside octree cells to better approximate sharp features.
